name: Ticker tape marquee
looks: A thin strip along the top or bottom edge scrolls a continuous row of short data tokens sideways at a steady, unending speed, like a stock ticker or a news wire running under the main scene.
build: A DOM row of tokens duplicated end to end inside an overflow:hidden strip; translateX runs linearly from the clock with no easing so the loop never stutters or stops.
sound: None, or a very quiet high-frequency tick bed.
prompt: Run a thin strip of short data tokens scrolling sideways along one edge of the frame, continuously and without easing, like a live wire. Keep it low-contrast and small, a texture under the main content rather than something to read.
